description: A beautifully hand-crafted pixel art ground surface for a dry ancient funerary court, 512x512 opaque, camera low oblique looking gently down at horizontal ground, no horizon, buildings, people or standing objects. The reference provides PIXEL CRAFT, palette and clean surfaces only. DIFFERENT LAYOUT: a broad quiet diagonal path of smooth packed ash earth flows from upper left to lower right. Beside it, groups of worn limestone flagstones, about 60-110 pixels wide and 25-45 pixels deep. Small and medium irregular horizontally elongated stone shapes, sparse larger stones, old chipped edges, one or two shallow hairline cracks per group. Some are half buried in ash. Stones cover roughly 40 percent, mostly at side edges; quiet earth covers 60 percent. No brick grid, no framed rectangles or coffin lids, no dense pebbles, no stippling. Clean connected pixel clusters, three tones for stone surfaces, two tones for ash. Shadow toward lower left from upper right light, compressed height and almost no raised vertical side. Beautiful nuanced shaped chips and edge highlights, broad untextured stone tops, subtle low contrast wind-smoothed ash. Earth has a few long connected flat colour bands, no random grain. Match a sophisticated 1x pixel game whose fighters are 130px tall; refined 1px edges, deliberate pixels, no blur, no gradients, no painterly dithering. Muted sepia, ash limestone, violet brown recesses, restrained dull ochre. Fill entire canvas. Do not add UI, text, water, vegetation or decorative motifs.
